description: Insolvency status of an Irish company from the Companies Registration Office register (CRO Open Data, CC BY 4.0, complete daily snapshot): procedure DERIVED from the published status (liquidation, liquidation stayed, examinership, administration) with its date; strike-off (listed or struck off) and dissolution reported separately; `aucune_procedure` is a measured fact on the complete snapshot (the CRO publishes neither the liquidator nor court orders). 400 without charge for a malformed number, 404 without charge when unknown, of an unknown CRO type or with a current name under objection (GDPR art. 21), 503 fail-closed without a fresh snapshot. Price $0.01. The company file itself is served by the generic EU company lookup with pays=IE. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

numero.description: Irish CRO company number: 1 to 7 digits, e.g. 600161 (IE prefix and leading zeros tolerated)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_irish_company_insolvency

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Irish company insolvency status (CRO)
